result.summary: The pedestrian environment features basic infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, though the markings are significantly faded. The presence of a large trailer and parked vehicles near the intersection creates visual obstructions, and the overall pavement quality is degraded.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large trailer and parked cars are positioned close to the intersection, blocking the view between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, near the corner.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces and the trailer storage area immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and further improve visibility.

result.summary: The environment features a two-lane roadway with integrated trolley tracks and marked zebra crosswalks. While sidewalks are present on both sides, visibility at the crossing is partially obstructed by parked vehicles, and there is a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the right side of the image obstruct the sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Trolley tracks
hazards.description: The presence of tracks in the roadway can create tripping hazards or catch small wheels (strollers, wheelchairs) if not crossed perpendicularly.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, traffic signals with pedestrian indicators, and continuous sidewalks. However, the lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or a median refuge increases pedestrian exposure to moving vehicles.

hazards.name: Wide turning radii
hazards.description: The absence of curb extensions allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning through the pedestrian crossing area.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance for pedestrians and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, which also helps in naturally calming traffic.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a two-lane roadway with integrated trolley tracks and marked zebra crosswalks. While sidewalks and basic traffic signals are present, the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and the presence of uneven pavement around the tracks pose risks to non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway create a trip hazard and can catch bicycle or stroller wheels.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway, running parallel to the direction of travel

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven surfaces near the crosswalk and tracks increase the risk of trips and falls.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface within and adjacent to the crosswalk area

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals to provide clear right-of-way and timing information.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the roadway surface, particularly around the tracks and crossing points.
